# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolmaster at Avonlea school  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Phillips  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Mr. Phillips is known for curling his mustache in school.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He exhibits a sarcastic, vindictive, and stern disposition toward his pupils. He is prone to spasmodic fits of reform regarding discipline, but is generally negligent toward younger students while focusing his attention on older ones. He frequently shows open favoritism toward certain pupils, particularly Prissy Andrews.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P57](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0057), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Negligent in school order  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Partial to older students  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching Latin and algebra  <sub>[v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)</sub>
- Reciting dramatic poetry  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- Preparing older pupils for the entrance examination into Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school, where he focused most of his efforts on preparing his advanced pupils for Queen's Academy while neglecting the younger children. During his tenure, he openly courted one of his older students, Prissy Andrews. He frequently disciplined pupils in a sarcastic manner, on one occasion making Anne Shirley stand in front of the blackboard with her name misspelled after she broke her slate over Gilbert Blythe's head. On another occasion, he forced Anne to sit with Gilbert Blythe as a punishment for arriving late, leading Anne to leave school for a period. At the end of the school term in June, he delivered an emotional farewell speech to his students before departing Avonlea. He was succeeded the following term by Miss Muriel Stacy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Secured the Avonlea schoolteacher position through his uncle, who served as a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Boarded at the house of Eben Wright while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
